panels.description: A House review team enters the rented workroom while Alex stands with Lina, Suri, Jalen and Ren. Use no recognizable crowd; keep the upper room clear.
Lock reviews the purifier's testing records across the worktable. Keep the upper records clear.
Lina gives Alex the worn bronze Maker's Seal; its open-hand mark projects contributor names and obligations. Keep the upper seal area clear.
Weeks later, a small Keel shop licenses the tested unit. A House notice about a competing industrial unit hangs behind Lock. Keep the upper shop sign clear.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Lina made the membrane. Suri kept the biofilter alive. Jalen built the routing. Ren made it serviceable.

items.speaker: LOCK
items.text: House administration would make this easier.

items.speaker: LINA
items.text: It would make the names disappear.

items.speaker: REN
items.text: If it fails, we answer for it.
